SPECIFICATION FOR 

COTTON DRILL ( NON-WATERPROOFED ) 

FOR UMBRELLAS 

(First Revislor) ) 



1. Scope — Prescribes the requirements of cotton drill (non-waterproofed) used in the manufacture 
of umbrellas. 

2. Manufacture — The cloth shall be even and firmly woven employing 2/1 twill weave. The selvedges 
shall be woven in rib or plain weave. The selvedges shall be strong and uniform and shall be not 
less than 20 mm in width. The cloth shall be calendered. The dyed cloth shall be dyed to the 
required shade using vat dyes or dyes possessing equal fastness properties. The dyed fabric shall 
be free from stains, streaks patches, etc. 

3. Requirement — As given in Tables 1 and 2.

4. Marking —-The cloth shall be marked with the following: 

a) Name of the material; 

b) Manufacturer's name, initials or trade-mark; and 

c) Month and year of manufacture. 

4.1 Certification Marking — DeiQWs available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

5. Packing — Unless otherwise specified, the cloth shall be packed in conformity with the procedure 
laid down In IS : 1 347-1 972 ' Specification for inland packaging of cotton cloth and yarn ( first revision ) ' 
or 13:293-1967 'Specification for seaworthy packaging of cotton cloth and yarn (second 
revision)'.
